about.story.title: Our Story
about.story.body: Just Women Can Change Society is a media and storytelling initiative founded by Afghan human rights activist and journalist Marwa Habibi. The organization was established to create space for Afghan women's voices in media, education, and storytelling. Our work is guided by principles of editorial integrity, dignity, inclusion, respect, safety, transparency, and accountability. We aim to amplify women's voices and provide a platform for their stories to be heard and shared globally.

about.goals.title: Our Goals
about.goals.short.title: Short-Term Goals
about.goals.short.copy: Our goal is to establish a media presence, disseminate narratives with precision, welcome volunteers, and expand learning opportunities. Each step depends on the individuals, resources, and measures necessary to carry it out responsibly.
about.goals.long.title: Long-Term Goals
about.goals.long.copy: In the long term, we hope to establish well-considered collaborations and gradually expand our educational programs. We intend to proceed at a pace that keeps the needs and safety of the participants at the forefront.
about.principles.title: Our Principles
about.principles.p1.title: Editorial independence
about.principles.p1.copy: Editorial decisions should be based on evidence, accuracy, and the public interest—not external pressure.
about.principles.p2.title: Informed consent
about.principles.p2.copy: Individuals should know how their words or images may be used before deciding to participate.
about.principles.p3.title: Fact-checking
about.principles.p3.copy: We strive to verify information and distinguish between what is known and what remains uncertain.
about.principles.p4.title: Privacy
about.principles.p4.copy: We are committed to protecting the privacy of all individuals involved in our work.
about.principles.p5.title: Source protection
about.principles.p5.copy: We consider potential risks before identifying a source or publishing sensitive content.
about.principles.p6.title: Corrections
about.principles.p6.copy: When an error is identified, we strive to review it and make a clear and appropriate correction.

about.media.title: Media & Stories
about.media.copy: Independent reporting and storytelling are part of the space we hope to create. For inquiries about this work or to start a conversation about sharing a story, reach out to us directly.

about.founder.label: FOUNDER & LEAD
about.founder.bio: Marwa Habibi is an Afghan human rights activist and journalist whose work spans independent reporting, documentary translation, poetry, and public speaking. Her writing and interviews have appeared through the BBC World Service, Afghanistan International, Amu TV, and independent literary platforms. She founded Just Women Can Change Society to create space for Afghan women's voices in media, education, and storytelling.
